headline: Philippe Echartoux visualizes waste problem through artistic project ‘After the Dream’
content: The French photographer has been living in Peru since his arrival in South America during World War II. His work focuses on capturing images related to social issues such as poverty, hunger, violence against women, among others.

headline: Opinion Columnists
content: In addition to being recognized photographers like Mario Testoni have also worked together creating their own brand of photography books which were published under the title Photography. They focus mainly on themes around nature conservation efforts within urban areas where there was little attention given to these topics before now.
